card.name: Linking words before drug-class names
card.fires_on: Small linking words like 'or', 'other', 'the' or 'and' that come right before a class name. Seen in hypersensitivity warnings ("or other beta-lactam", "member of the quinolone class") and in lists of Apple devices.

modes.label: Hypersensitivity to class
modes.description: Linking word after a named drug, ahead of its drug class, in contraindication text.
modes.example: known serious hypersensitivity to ceftaroline or other members of<< the>> cephalosporin class.

modes.label: Apple device lists
modes.description: 'or' or 'and' between Apple product names in tech text.
modes.example: on your iPhone, iPad<< or>> iTouch.

card.writes: Little clear output effect; it mildly favors Apple/browser-related names and suppresses touch-related words.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a drug class or a second device name in a list.
